lines: Grasper always seeing, by Khecarī succeeds clearly; Vidyā-doubter, mala-doubter, śāstra-doubter not succeeds.
l4.sanskrit_cite: grahītāraṃ sadā paśyan khecaryā siddhyati sphuṭam vidyāśaṅkī malāśaṅkī śāstraśaṅkī na siddhyati
